name: Rex plan maps blocked credentials, failure, and resumed work without opening a backend session
Record export is inert by default and copies only allowed records after opt-in
Record archive commits integrity metadata and an exact retry preserves the committed archive
Unsafe source symlink is refused while the last published record snapshot survives
Per-mate file pin wins over global mate grammar, which wins over the default profile
Timed executor preserves stdin and stops an overlong real subprocess promptly
Answered hold remains verifiable after real tasks-axi archives it to a TOML-escaped path
